description: List recent events in AI coding agents, ranked by score and heat. Use it for questions like "what is new in AI coding agents?", "what happened today?", "any big launches this week?". Optional: hours to look back (default 24, at most 168), limit (default 10, at most 25). Returns up to limit events, each with a title, a short summary, a category, a 0 to 10 score, a heat count of independent sources within 48 hours, and links to those sources with their dates, plus asOf, the time the sources were last read. The same event reported by several outlets is one event.

hours.description: Look back this many hours (default 24, at most 168)

niche.description: The topic area to read. Only "ai-coding-agents" (AI coding agents) exists today, and it is the default.

name: latest_events

asOf.description: When the sources were last read completely

heat.description: Independent sources that reported the event within 48 hours of its first report

total.description: Matching events before the limit was applied

title: Get the latest AI coding agent events
